color.note: Tesselle: limewash and night grounds, three mineral hues (argile, faïence, ocre) plus a calm dusk for well-being and harissa red for real errors only. Jour is the projector theme and the fallback; Nuit is the 11 pm theme.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: limewash by day, night blue-black by night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, answer bubbles, inputs, the quiz card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the student's own messages, tracks behind mastery bars and timers, the busy banner, the receipt.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the feedback reason picker: anything floating above a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders. Decorative only: never the only thing that shows a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, empty tesserae). Holds 3:1 on ground, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised and on every -soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, placeholders; on ground, surface and surface-sunken (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: argile
tokens.usage: Terracotta, EdNova's own voice: the primary action, the clarify badge, the not-yet verdict, links. As text on ground, surface or argile-soft.

tokens.name: argile-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an argile fill or argile text.

tokens.name: argile-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind argile text: the clarify badge, the not-yet verdict, a selected choice.

tokens.name: on-argile
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an argile or argile-strong fill (the primary button's label). Never literal white in Nuit.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in answers and settings. An alias of argile.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring). 3:1 or more on every ground and surface.

tokens.name: faience
tokens.usage: Glazed teal, the textbook's colour: the course badge, source chips, the correct verdict, climbed hint steps. As text on ground, surface or faience-soft.

tokens.name: faience-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind faience text: the course badge, the correct verdict, the course excerpt card.

tokens.name: on-faience
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a faience fill.

tokens.name: ocre
tokens.usage: Saffron, reward and attention: streak flowers' hearts, the solved step of the hint ladder, the not-found badge mark. A fill only: in Jour it is too light for text (use ocre-ink).

tokens.name: ocre-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ocre-ink or ink text: the not-found badge, the incomplete verdict, the streak card.

tokens.name: ocre-ink
tokens.usage: Ochre as text and icon on ground, surface or ocre-soft.

tokens.name: on-ocre
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ocre fill.

tokens.name: calm
tokens.usage: Dusk mist, the well-being surface. Used by WellbeingMessage and the well-being verdict only, never for errors or regular answers.

tokens.name: calm-ink
tokens.usage: Text on calm.

tokens.name: calm-accent
tokens.usage: The jasmine glyph and quiet marks on calm (3:1 or more on calm).

tokens.name: harissa
tokens.usage: Real errors only: form errors, a failed stream, the delete-account action. Never for a wrong maths answer. As text on ground, surface or harissa-soft.

tokens.name: harissa-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind harissa text (an inline form error, the delete confirmation).

tokens.name: on-harissa
tokens.usage: Text on a harissa fill (the confirm-delete button).

tokens.name: rail-active
tokens.usage: The selected NavRail item: a dark tile set into the rail in both themes.

tokens.name: on-rail-active
tokens.usage: Icon and label on rail-active.

tokens.name: rail-active-edge
tokens.usage: Inset edge of the selected rail item. In Nuit it gives the dark tile 3:1 against the rail (surface).

tokens.name: mastery-unknown
tokens.usage: Outline of an empty tessera: a chapter with no data yet.

tokens.name: mastery-weak
tokens.usage: One filled tessera (weak). Sequential teal ramp, light to dark in Jour, dark to light in Nuit, each step 3:1 or more on surface; always paired with the fill count and a word.

tokens.name: mastery-medium
tokens.usage: Two filled tesserae (medium).

tokens.name: mastery-strong
tokens.usage: Four filled tesserae (strong).

tokens.name: tier-argile
tokens.usage: Badge tier 1, Argile (common): the square tessera.

tokens.name: tier-faience
tokens.usage: Badge tier 2, Faïence (uncommon): the octagon tile.

tokens.name: tier-marbre
tokens.usage: Badge tier 3, Marbre (rare): the eight-point star.

tokens.name: tier-lapis
tokens.usage: Badge tier 4, Lapis (epic): the twelve-point rosette.

tokens.name: tier-or
tokens.usage: Badge tier 5, Or (legendary): the sixteen-point medallion. Rarity is carried by shape and name first; colour is the third cue.

tokens.name: mark-ribbon
tokens.usage: The Rise mark's ribbon (the N), from the supplied logo files. Logo only.

tokens.name: mark-turn
tokens.usage: The Rise mark's turned page, the one warm fold. Logo only.

tokens.name: nova-jasmine
tokens.usage: Jasmine petals in the streak flowers. Always outlined with line-strong or set on a darker shape.

families.math: KaTeX_Main, "Latin Modern Roman", "Times New Roman", serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Kufam, a Kufic-inspired geometric face drawn as an Arabic and Latin pair, hosted on Google Fonts. Big moments only: screen titles, onboarding, numbers that celebrate.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Onboarding titles and the home greeting on a laptop. Drops to display under 640px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles inside a screen, card titles on the home dashboard.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The running timer, streak count, mastery gained. Digits sit in fixed-width cells (StudyTimer) so they never jitter.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Readex Pro, built for reading ease, with Arabic in the same family. Hosted on Google Fonts.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings, the question in a quiz card, chapter names in lists.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: On cherche la probabilité que B se réalise sachant que A est réalisé.
styles.usage: Answer text in the chat, hints, the well-being message. Long reading at night.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pose ta question : je cherche d’abord dans ton manuel.
styles.usage: Default UI text, form fields, descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, source chips, helper text under fields.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The AI label and tiny counters. Never smaller than 12px.

groups.name: Maths
groups.note: KaTeX, shipped as files. Formulas are always typeset by MathText, never written as plain text.

styles.name: math
styles.usage: Specimen of the maths face. In product, MathText renders formulas at 1.21em of the surrounding text.

groups.name: Arabic
groups.note: The same Readex Pro family covers Arabic, so the right-to-left interface needs no new font.

styles.name: arabic
styles.usage: Arabic body text for the right-to-left roadmap; looser leading than Latin.

spacing.note: 4px base. grout is the 2px gap between tesserae everywhere: mastery tiles, segmented bars, the stage indicator.

tokens.name: grout
tokens.usage: Gap between tesserae and between segments of a bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between messages.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Answer bubble padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on laptops; between groups in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Well-being message padding; onboarding card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen top padding on laptops.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and empty states.

radius.note: Cut stone, not pebbles: small radii on tiles, one soft shape (pebble) reserved for well-being.

tokens.name: radius-tessera
tokens.usage: Tesserae: mastery tiles, stage tiles, hint steps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips (source, next step, badges), checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and answer bubbles (one corner cut square where the bubble meets its speaker).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, onboarding cards.

tokens.name: radius-pebble
tokens.usage: The well-being message only, so its outline alone sets it apart.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggles, the timer ring.

shadow.note: Flat like a mosaic floor: borders first, one soft lift for cards, one float for menus.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards and answer bubbles at rest, with a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the reason picker.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground-coloured gap, then 2px of solid argile. Box-shadow so it follows the radius; shown on :focus-visible only.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside cards (pointer devices only; padding grows them to size-touch on touch).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target on touch screens.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: The composer, onboarding buttons, the primary action on phones.

tokens.name: width-chat
tokens.usage: Max width of the chat column and of reading text.

tokens.name: width-rail
tokens.usage: Context panel beside the NavRail on laptops (sessions in the tutor, chapters on the map); hidden under 1024px.

tokens.name: width-shell
tokens.usage: Max width of the app shell on a projector.

motion.note: One easing and three durations, first taken from the retired ui-preview CSS.
